## About
Marin Auto Glass is a small shop on Hamilton Drive in Novato. We repair and replace any piece of glass on any make or model of vehicle, and we tint windows too.
Bring your car to the shop, or have one of our mobile technicians meet you at home, at work or wherever you are. If you're claiming the work on your insurance, we'll manage the paperwork for you.
Ray and Said own the place, and customers tell us they notice the difference. We're rated 4.8 from 91 Google reviews.

## Services
- Windshield replacements: Cracked or chipped windshield replaced on any make or model.
- Auto glass repair: Our trained expert looks closely at what your windshield needs before any work starts.
- Any piece of glass, any vehicle: We can repair or replace any piece of glass on any make or model of vehicle.
- Tinting all the windows: Window tinting for your whole car.
- Mobile service: Our mobile technicians come to you at home, at work or wherever you are.
- Insurance paper work: If you're claiming the work on your vehicle insurance, we'll manage all your insurance paper work for you.

## FAQ
Q: Can you come to me instead?
A: Yes. You can bring your car to our shop in Novato, or one of our mobile technicians can come to you at home or at work.

Q: Will you deal with my insurance company?
A: We have strong relationships with most of the major insurance companies, so if you're claiming the work on your vehicle insurance, we'll manage the paperwork for you.

Q: Is your work guaranteed?
A: Yes. Our workmanship is guaranteed.
